# Postgres settings

Sources: `deploy/postgres/gucs.yaml`; PLAN.md 9.1; register N114, N122, N131, N139, N166, N167.

One table feeds the `postgres -c` include file, the `ALTER ROLE` statements and `engramctl config lint`. `prod` is the
value on a 128 GB, 8 vCPU shard host and `dev` the same setting scaled for the single-host compose. Scopes: `server` =
postgresql.conf, `role` = ALTER ROLE, `storage` = per-table storage parameter set by the migrations, `txn` = `SET LOCAL`
inside a transaction by `engramctl`.

## Container

| Profile | cpus | memory | shm_size |
|---|---|---|---|
| dev | `2` | `2g` | `1g` |
| prod | `8` | `112g` | `32g` |

### Server kinds and notes

- `shared_buffers`: N114: hot set 74 GB at 5.5 M facts
- `effective_cache_size`: N114
- `maintenance_work_mem`: N138: the index runner raises it
- `max_parallel_maintenance_workers`: N138, N173
- `max_connections` (temporal `400`): N164: 63 at P = 4 API processes; temporal-postgres: the pools of the four Temporal
  services sum to 260
- `work_mem`: section 9.1
- `synchronous_commit` (catalog `on`; standby `on`; temporal `on`): N122: no synchronous standby of a shard; N163: the
  catalog is on locally with an asynchronous standby
- `synchronous_standby_names` (only on catalog): N163: asynchronous standby
- `hot_standby` (only on catalog, standby): N163
- `max_wal_senders` (only on catalog, standby): N163 (standby >= primary)
- `max_replication_slots` (only on catalog, standby): N163 (standby >= primary)
- `max_slot_wal_keep_size` (only on catalog, standby): review M0.4 m7
- `checkpoint_timeout`: N166
- `max_wal_size`: N166
- `checkpoint_completion_target`: N166
- `wal_compression`: N166
- `tcp_keepalives_idle`: N167, C-10: a vanished host releases advisory locks
- `tcp_keepalives_interval`: N167
- `tcp_keepalives_count`: N167
- `tcp_user_timeout`: N167: direct connections (leases, relay, mover)
- `wal_level`: RPO <= 60 s
- `archive_mode`: RPO <= 60 s (on a standby: archives after a promotion)
- `archive_timeout`: RPO <= 60 s
- `archive_command`: N131
- `autovacuum_max_workers`: P-11
- `autovacuum_freeze_max_age`: P-11
- `autovacuum_freeze_min_age`: P-11: content partitions, migration 0002
- `vacuum_index_cleanup`: N138, N152: vector partitions, permanently
- `random_page_cost`: NVMe
- `effective_io_concurrency`: NVMe
- `max_parallel_workers_per_gather`: NVMe
- `shared_preload_libraries` (plain servers `pg_stat_statements`): section 9.1 (+ pg_cron of the ParadeDB bootstrap)
- `log_min_duration_statement`: section 9.1
- `log_lock_waits`: section 9.1
- `lock_timeout_exclusive`: N82, N120, N124, N139: one attempt, SET LOCAL

### Unsized servers

On the servers of kind catalog, standby, temporal these settings stay at the PostgreSQL defaults until someone sizes
them: shared_buffers, effective_cache_size, maintenance_work_mem, max_parallel_maintenance_workers, work_mem,
max_wal_size, autovacuum_max_workers, autovacuum_freeze_max_age, max_parallel_workers_per_gather,
effective_io_concurrency, random_page_cost.

## Role settings

- `engram_admin`: `idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 30s`, `lock_timeout = 10s`, `statement_timeout = 30s`,
  `synchronous_commit = local`
- `engram_app`: `idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 30s`, `lock_timeout = 2s`, `plan_cache_mode = force_custom_plan`,
  `statement_timeout = 30s`, `synchronous_commit = local`
- `engram_move`: `idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 30s`, `lock_timeout = 10s`, `statement_timeout = 30s`,
  `synchronous_commit = local`
- `engram_relay`: `synchronous_commit = local`
